newsitem.title: FINLAND: FORECAST - AAMULEHTI 1996 PROFIT SEEN UP.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - AAMULEHTI 1996 PROFIT SEEN UP.

text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts
covering Finnish equities showed a 105 million markka median
forecast for Finnish publishing group Aamulehti Oy's full-year
1996 profit before extraordinary items and tax.
Profit before extras, tax EPS
(FIM million) (markka)
Median 105 9.40
Lowest 100 7.70
Highest 151 12.50
(Profit forecasts by 11 analysts, EPS by nine analysts)
Aamulehti's results are due on Feb 13.
In 1995, Aamulehti had a 87 million markka profit before
extraordinary items and tax.
For the company's full-year 1997 profit, seven of the 11
analysts polled gave a median forecast of 115 million markka
(mean 120 million) in a 95 to 149 million markka range.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Aktia Bank,
Carnegie Securities, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM
Securities, Interbank, Kleinwort Benson Securities, Merita
Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
